title: WATCH: Mehdi’s Most Memorable Moments of 2025
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Between heated debates with former Trump chief of staff **Mick Mulvaney** and
former British cabinet minister **Michael Gove** , getting **Piers Morgan** to
agree with him on the Gaza genocide, the viral Jubilee 'Surrounded' video, and
his iconic speeches at the Wembley Arena Palestine concert and the DC 'No
Kings' protest, **Mehdi 's** jam-packed year felt more like a decade.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe?)

So as 2025 comes to a close, take a look back at some of Mehdi's best, most
memorable, most viral moments.

And if that's how 2025 went, we're already holding our breaths for 2026!
